featured.lead: Built end to end, proven by measurement
featured.title: Two projects
featured.note: Both are written up as case studies: problem → cause → fix → result.

items.name: Moving
items.desc: Moving-quote matching with real-time 1:1 chat. I owned the notification and chat APIs through to the UI, and used measurement to find and fix performance bottlenecks and redundant chat refetches.

items.name: K-TEST
items.meta: Team project · Sole frontend · Hackathon award
items.desc: A Korean speaking test on job and safety topics for foreign workers. I built the entire test flow on my own — from identity verification and answering questions to the result report.

items.body: I reproduce issues to find the cause, then measure after the fix to confirm it really got better.
As a lead, I watch FE·BE dependencies first. As a teammate, I dig into blockers together.
Having worked from design to APIs and databases, I close the gaps from both the UI and the server side.
From designer to developer, from frontend to full-stack — I keep widening my range.
